title: Print TOC Title and Page Number Bug
description: The print/tex table of contents (Inhaltsverzeichnis) shows the project/document title repeated for every chapter/section/paragraph entry instead of the actual heading text, and the page number column repeats the last page instead of showing the page where each chapter/section actually starts. Fix both bugs in print/tex/semio-window.sty (and semio-table.sty if needed).
summary:
Fixed three distinct bugs in print/tex/semio-window.sty that combined to make TOC entries show the document title repeated with the last page number:

1. Title fallback to document title: `\semio_window_toc_title_plain:n`'s outer `\tl_if_in:nnT` was a single-branch (true-only) expl3 conditional, but the code supplied a 4th brace group as if it were a false-branch — that group executed unconditionally as a plain TeX scope that locally overwrote `\l_tmpa_tl` with the correct title, then discarded it on group-close, leaving whatever `\l_tmpa_tl` held from `\SemioChromeNavbarLabelsCompute` (`\@title`, i.e. the project title) as the "title" for every heading. Fixed by using `\tl_if_in:nnTF`.

2. Same title text for headings sharing a label: TOC labels were built from `semio-toc-<level>-<number>`, so unnumbered/starred headings sharing the same level+number (e.g. two `\chapter*` chapters) collided on one `\label`, and `\getpagerefnumber` resolved every colliding row to whichever heading's `\newlabel` was written last. Fixed by suffixing labels with a monotonically incrementing global counter (`\g_semio_toc_label_int`) so every heading occurrence gets a unique label.

3. Page number always equal to the last row's page: `\semio_window_register_body_macro_apply:n` (the shared renderer behind TOC, list-of-figures, glossary, etc.) built each row's label via `\tl_set:Nn \l_tmpe_tl { \str_use:N \l_tmpd_str }` (n-type, non-expanding) instead of `\tl_set:Nx`, so it stored a *deferred* macro call referencing the shared scratch variable `\l_tmpd_str` rather than freezing its current value. Since the table body is only typeset later (at `\clearpage`), every row's stored "label" call resolved, at render time, to whatever `\l_tmpd_str` held after the *last* loop iteration — making every row show the last chapter's page. Fixed by using `\tl_set:Nx` to eagerly resolve the label per iteration.

Also fixed two adjacent, previously-masked title-extraction bugs uncovered once (1) stopped clobbering results:
- The `\Sectionformat{title}{...}` extraction used an intermediate `\def\raw{#1}` wrapper macro, whose expansion-while-matching caused `\Sectionformat` (when redefined, e.g. by KOMA) to over-expand past the intended delimiter; fixed by matching directly against `#1` instead of an indirect macro. Also made the pattern tolerant of a leading `\Hy@SectionAnchorHref{...}` anchor prefix seen on unnumbered/anchored headings.
- The `\interlinepenalty \@M <title>\@@par` wrapper (present on \chapter-level headings) used a `\def`-based delimited-argument extraction inside `\ExplSyntaxOff`, which broke because `@` was catcode-other (not letter) at that point in the file, so literal `\@M`/`\@@par` in the pattern never matched the real (letter-catcode) tokens; also hit an unsupported `\exp_args:NVn` combination. Replaced with a `\makeatletter`-scoped, string-level `\str_replace_all:Nnn` (registering an `NVn` variant via `\cs_generate_variant:Nn`) that strips the known wrapper tokens safely.

Verified by rebuilding all 12 print template PDFs (`bun nx run @semio-tech/print:build` and `:test`, all exit 0) and visually inspecting rendered TOC pages (report, forschungsbericht, zwischenbericht) via a throwaway pdfjs-based PNG renderer in the ticket folder — all show correct distinct titles and correct per-chapter page numbers instead of the repeated project title / repeated last page.
